html: II. זִיז n.[m.] abundance, fulness: only מִזִּיז כְּבוֹדָהּ Is 66:11 that ye may suck out and be delighted, from the abundance of her glory (i.e. of Jerusalem) (so Di al.; > Che crit. n., and OP 472 f. Brd (cf. Ew ‘Euter’), who comp. vulg. Ar. zîza, udder (breast, teat); this suits vb. תָּמֹצּוּ and ‖ תִּינְקוּ וּשְׂבַעְתֶּם מִשֹּׁד, but is dub. in Heb., perh. not Shemit., v. Dozy i. 619 a and reff.; also LagProph. Chald. who proposes, plausibly, מִבִּיו, cf. Aramaic ܒܶܙܳܐ PS 502, ביזא; Arabic بزّ pap).
